cases.title: Arrest for driving under the influence
cases.text:
Police arrested Shaniqua Freeton (DL, Bearcats) overnight after a traffic stop; officers reported a blood alcohol level above the legal limit.

The club has issued a short statement and says it is cooperating with the league.
